author: Ankit & Priya
text: The valley view from our private balcony was worth the trip alone. The bonfire evening with the staff was a lovely surprise!

author: Rohit Malhotra
text: Good multi-cuisine food at the restaurant and the kids loved the play zone. Staff arranged a cab for us to Tarkeshwar temple with no hassle.

author: Siddharth Rawat
text: The 2N/3D group departure package from Delhi was seamless. The fairy lights on the outdoor lawn and DJ evening made our anniversary unforgettable.
